aboutSubheading: Passionate about plants and outdoor spaces
aboutText: Botanico Gardens has been crafting beautiful outdoor spaces for homes and businesses across Yarraville and Melbourne's inner west. Our dedicated team brings genuine horticultural knowledge and creative design sense to every project, from small courtyard makeovers to full-scale landscape transformations. We take pride in understanding what grows best in Melbourne's climate and delivering gardens our clients love spending time in, day after day.
servicesText: From routine maintenance to complete garden redesigns, Botanico Gardens offers a comprehensive range of services tailored to Yarraville homeowners and businesses who value quality outdoor spaces.

services.title: Garden Design & Landscaping
services.desc: Custom garden plans designed around your space, style, and how you actually use your outdoor area.

services.title: Garden Maintenance
services.desc: Regular mowing, pruning, weeding and tidying to keep your Yarraville garden looking its best year-round.

services.title: Planting & Garden Bed Creation
services.desc: Expert plant selection and installation suited to Melbourne's climate and your garden's conditions.

services.title: Turf & Lawn Care
services.desc: Laying fresh turf, lawn repairs, and ongoing care for a healthy green lawn you can enjoy daily.

services.title: Hedging & Tree Work
services.desc: Professional hedging, shaping and small tree removal to keep your garden neat and well-structured.

services.title: Hard Landscaping
services.desc: Paving, retaining walls, garden edging and structural features that complement your green spaces.
